data.headline: Avoid generic rebrand; buy Bosch GSR 18V-65 instead

reasons.text: Same tool sold under at least 8 brands (YUNXI, KORAWALT, VXB, JEXUGK, MPT, Adrinfly, JRK, Olmlmo), a classic throwaway rebrand with no independent support or spare parts.
User reports show chuck failure after 4 weeks and motor failure after 2 weeks, contradicting the 4.7-star average and 1832 reviews.
Advertised 21V is only the unloaded peak voltage of an 18V pack; spec inflation is common on generic tools and misleads buyers.
Cost per year is higher than Bosch or Makita due to likely short life; Bosch GSR 18V-65 costs €78.99 with established service and 31 offers.
